relationships.evidence: the player think calls the stealth-factor virtual when curtime reaches the saved deadline and schedules the next pass by 0.1 seconds
the recompute resolves Sneaking through CharacterData before indexing the sight and cone tables
SetClosestPlayer publishes the selected NPC and distance to the target player's HUD observer transaction
the Troika NPC think refreshes closest-player distance before calling SetPlayerLOS
GatherConditions calls GatherEnemyConditions only after sense refresh memory update and enemy choice
the VHuman admission body calls target virtual slot 0x70 and multiplies it by observer field 0x63b8
SetPlayerLOS tests the closest player through FInViewCone before near-range or trace LOS
after calling base StartTouch the specialized body independently increments a touching combat character by the trigger's authored value
after calling base EndTouch the specialized body independently decrements a touching combat character by the trigger's authored value

findings.fact: The player recomputes a target-side sight-distance scalar, cone scalar and hearing-distance reduction every 0.1 seconds, but refreshes only one of feet, centre and head light per pass.
findings.evidence: Player think 0x10350830 schedules 0.1 seconds; recompute 0x103517e0 cycles field 0x1c7c and writes 0x1c70, 0x1c74 and 0x1c78 from Stealth.txt.
findings.consequence: A complete light triplet can lag by about 0.3 seconds; these values belong to the target/player surface, not to any one observer.

findings.fact: Visual range is observer effective vision multiplied by the target player's current sight-distance scalar; target cone scaling is applied separately by FInViewCone.
findings.evidence: VHuman admission 0x102b4760 multiplies target virtual slot 0x70 by observer field 0x63b8 before the distance rejection. FInViewCone 0x10326750 calls target slot 0x74 while applying observer cone field 0x1574.
findings.consequence: Light and Sneaking do not hide the player by toggling one boolean; they reshape two different observer tests.

findings.fact: Closest-player cone and LOS are cached on a two-second cadence. At or below 512 units, cone admission grants LOS without a trace; farther targets use mask 0x4091, and lost LOS remains true for eight seconds while the target stays in cone.
findings.evidence: SetPlayerLOS 0x10291610 uses constants 2.0, 512.0 and 8.0 and writes fields 0x6278 through 0x6284.
findings.consequence: Detection has deliberate cadence and hysteresis; it cannot be reproduced by an every-frame raycast or by clearing visibility immediately on the first obstruction.

findings.fact: Stealth hearing subtracts the player's table-derived distance from an eligible emitted sound radius and floors the result at zero.
findings.evidence: AdjustSoundDistForStealth 0x1009d850 calls target virtual slot 0x78, subtracts the result and clamps negative radii to zero before insertion consumers continue.
findings.consequence: Hearing stealth changes stimulus reach before normal NPC hearing and memory; it is not an observer hearing multiplier.

findings.fact: trigger_stealth_mod contributes its authored integer on StartTouch and removes the same contribution on paired EndTouch. Contributions stack in an unbounded aggregate, while the getter alone clamps the effective modifier to minus ten through ten.
findings.evidence: CStealthModifier 0x101cba00 and 0x101cba40 call the base callbacks and then independently call 0x1032f930 and 0x1032f9f0 against combat-character field 0x1084; getter 0x1032fab0 clamps only its return.
findings.consequence: Overlapping volumes compose and must balance by contact lease; storing only a clamped value would make later exits restore the wrong Sneaking rating.

findings.confidence: confirmed static with live timing open
findings.fact: Direct sight, remembered stimulus, committed enemy and map outputs are distinct transitions.
findings.evidence: SetPlayerLOS only writes cached sensory fields. GatherConditions 0x1026ec30 then refreshes senses and memory before ChooseEnemy and GatherEnemyConditions 0x10270b20. The latter fires OnFoundPlayer after admitted committed-enemy LOS and OnLostPlayerLOS only after ten consecutive failed checks; OnLostPlayer belongs to the later eluded-memory loss path in ChooseEnemy.
findings.consequence: OnFoundPlayer, OnLostPlayerLOS and OnLostPlayer must not be aliases for a single detection boolean or for the enemy-handle write.
